_meta._invoice_status_note: See recipes/image/invoice-status.json[seedream-v4-default]. ESTIMATE — UNVERIFIED. Slug wired fresh 2026-05-05; invoice reconciliation pending.

max_images._note: If using sequential endpoint, must match prompt-declared 'a series of N images' count.

negative_prompt_policy._note: Seedream has no separate negative_prompt field. Express constraints inline. Edit prompts use 'replace [A] with [B]; keep [identity]; preserve [lighting]' grammar.

reference_syntax._note: Edit/sequential-edit endpoints accept reference images. Default T2I does not.

official_prompt_template._ordering: action + object + target_feature [+ ', a series of {N} images, [style locks]' if sequential]

validator_rules.throws: seedream-v4: prompt-declared count ({declared}) must equal max_images ({max_images}). Sequential generation requires both to agree.
seedream-v4: endpoint_variant='sequential' but prompt lacks 'a series of N' or style-lock language. Sequential generation will fail without explicit series declaration.
